messages.content: Invoice discrepancy on PO-8842. Nova Retail was quoted USD 45,000 for the annual insulated bottle program, but invoice INV-2026-0394 shows USD 52,500. Procurement says they will hold payment if we cannot explain the USD 7,500 delta by tomorrow.
Helio Kids says sample batch S-778 failed CPSIA lead screening at their incoming QC. They want a written containment plan today before they release the 80k-unit PO.
Kappa Home is threatening to switch supplier because Jake never sent the revised MOQ and tier-price proposal for bamboo organizers. They say they asked twice last week.
Factory Fuzhou-17 missed the vessel cutoff for PO-9015 after typhoon closure. Buyer still needs goods in LA by May 20. There may be an air-sea recovery option but surcharge ownership is unclear.
Unrelated: buy cheap followers for your store. No customer action required.
Please do not reply directly to Helio until Compliance signs off. Their legal team is copied on the thread and any CPSIA language must be precise.

Orion Market says supplier Fuzhou-17 sent them a new bank account for PO-9015 surcharge prepayment and asked for wire confirmation by 16:00 today. Orion wants to know whether they should pay the new account or hold.
